description: The bar chart illustrates the percent point difference in performance between mBERT and XLM-R models across four different hidden layer configurations, with the horizontal axis displaying the categories: 'hidden:[50], linear', 'hidden:[], linear', 'hidden:[100], ReLU', and 'hidden:[50, 50], ReLU'. The vertical axis represents the '% point difference' on a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each category contains two bars: mBERT, shown in light blue, and XLM-R, shown in dark blue. In the 'hidden:[50], linear' category, mBERT has a value of approximately -0.15, while XLM-R is at about -0.1. For 'hidden:[], linear', mBERT is at approximately 0.1 and XLM-R is at approximately 0.25. In 'hidden:[100], ReLU', mBERT is at approximately -0.1 and XLM-R is slightly below zero, around -0.05. In 'hidden:[50, 50], ReLU', mBERT is at approximately -0.15 and XLM-R is at approximately -0.1. The chart includes a legend to distinguish the models, and the bars are not sorted in any particular order, with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any category.

Each category contains two bars representing different models: mBERT, shown in light blue, and XLM-R, displayed in dark blue. In the 'hidden:[50], linear' category, the mBERT bar has a negative approximate value of -0.15, while XLM-R has -0.1. The 'hidden:[], linear' category shows mBERT with an approximate value of 0.1, and XLM-R with an approximate higher value of 0.25.
